samples.question: A 4-bit register is shown: the rightmost cell is the ones place and each cell leftward doubles the place value. A solid dark cell is bit 1 (filled) and a white cell with a dark ring is bit 0 (outline). The orange ring marks the TARGET cell. The green up-triangles below declare successive increment-by-one operations, applied left to right. The register is never drawn again. Replay the increments from the shown start (propagating carries). What is the FINAL state of the ringed target cell? Answer 'filled' or 'outline'.
